title: Ramified base-parameter powers are cofinal
statement: For a coefficient stage s over a finite extension E of Q_l, the image of the fixed base uniformizer in the integer ring of s.field is a unit times v^e for a positive integer e, where v is the chosen upper uniformizer. Thus its nth principal-power ideal is the chosen upper coefficient ideal at en, and the indices en for positive n are cofinal.

source.place: Finite coefficient stages and cofinal ramified indices; the arithmetic part of lem-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-comparisons.

proof.text: The embedding takes the base uniformizer to a nonzero nonunit. In the upper DVR expand it as a unit times v^e. The exponent cannot be zero, since the image is nonunit. Raising to n and discarding the unit gives the ideal equality. For any r take n=r+1; positivity of e gives r≤e*n.

proof_origin.place: Direct DVR expansion and integral-closure/quotient-base-change arguments.

lean.statement:
theorem stage_ramification (s : Stage l E) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ+) (z : s.integersˣ),
      s.parameter = (z : s.integers) *
        Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l s.field ^ (e : ℕ) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, Ideal.span ({s.parameter} : Set s.integers) ^ n =
        Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l s.field ((e : ℕ) * n)) ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ+, r ≤ (e : ℕ) * (n : ℕ)
